note: Pre-release snapshot. Entries whose source is null are declared but not yet published; fetching them fails with a clear error. Sources, artifact lists, and inference metadata are completed as components publish.

components.name: interpreter
components.description: Small local language model + system prompt + few-shot examples + decoding grammar. Maps a free-text description to per-slot texture prompts and the semantic hair block. Model selection is in progress; the blessed default arrives as registry data.

components.name: make-figure
components.description: Text to body: deterministic prompt-to-parameters heads plus normalization statistics and owned-position index maps. Consumes the base model's text encoder.

components.name: make-skin
components.description: Full-body skin albedo on the body's canonical UV atlas.

components.name: make-eye
components.description: The eye albedo (iris and sclera), applied to both eyes on the eyeball's concentric UV layout.

components.name: make-garment
components.description: Clothing over an unoccupied background on the body's canonical UV atlas; coverage recovered by luminance key at assembly.

components.name: make-shoe
components.description: Footwear on the foot ('shoe') regions of the body's canonical UV atlas, composited above garments. The launch component supports below-ankle styles only, declared here so the interpreter clamps footwear prompts accordingly.

components.name: body-rig
components.description: The pinned MHR rig (TorchScript forward + LOD1 topology/UVs), mirrored with attribution, plus rig metadata: topology checksum and the authoritative 127-joint name table (added at publish).

components.name: flux2-klein-4b
components.description: FLUX.2 Klein 4B (Black Forest Labs, Apache-2.0): transformer + text encoder + VAE. Fetched from its upstream repository, pinned to an exact revision at publish; the identity component shares its text encoder.

components.name: assembly-assets
components.description: Static assembly assets: eyeball and lash meshes/textures (MIT, attributed in NOTICE), UV coverage templates, atlas metadata.

components.name: make-wig
components.description: The default hair provider: a procedural wig synthesizer consuming the character's semantic hair block and the assembled head/body geometry. Vendored in the package; this entry records versions for provenance and future model-driven variants.
